results.detail: Tests in temporary directories prove that improve writes a candidate under .factory/candidates/ and leaves every stable canonical file byte-identical; that capture-failure appends a persistent case which a later eval and challenge both include; that challenge runs validation and the union of stable and candidate cases against both sides, writes challenge.json and challenge.md, and returns candidate-worse when a trigger case that passed on stable fails on the candidate and candidate-unsafe when the candidate has a validation error; that promote refuses a candidate-worse or candidate-unsafe verdict with a non-zero exit and changes nothing, and on an acceptable verdict replaces the stable skill, packages a new awaiting-approval version and keeps the previous version directory intact; that nothing in the pipeline or run command calls promote; and that skills/skill-factory/SKILL.md was improved through the loop with its challenge report committed as evidence and still passes skillz validate
